subject: Request: Premium support + custom connector — pricing & exec approval needed
messages:
From: Aisha Banerjee <aisha.b@gentrix.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Gentrix Procurement <procurement@gentrix.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.p@gentrix.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Premium support + custom Azure AD connector — scope & ask

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Gentrix Systems is excited about Redwood — two asks from our side before legal/procurement can move forward:

1) We need Redwood to include the Premium Support plan (24/7 with a named TAM) for the first 12 months at no additional charge as part of the committed bundle. That is critical for our customers during initial rollout.
2) We require a custom Azure AD connector to sit behind our VPC (SSO + group sync). The doc attached (TechnicalSpec_AzureAD_connector.docx) outlines required capabilities — estimated effort looks non-trivial.

Commercially, our procurement team is requesting a 20% one-time onboarding credit/discount on the first-year committed spend in return for a 24-month contract and a minimum monthly committed usage. We recognize this is outside standard terms — happy to discuss.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the support inclusion and cover the custom connector dev as part of the onboarding package, or what approvals are required? Timeline is tight — we aim to start onboarding Nov 2.

Attached: Gentrix_SOW_v1.pdf, TechnicalSpec_AzureAD_connector.docx

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Banerjee
Head of Product Partnerships | Gentrix Systems
+aisha.b@gentrix.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Banerjee <aisha.b@gentrix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Gentrix Procurement <procurement@gentrix.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Premium support + custom Azure AD connector — scope & ask

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the clear ask and the spec. I’ve looped in Marissa (Head of Professional Services) and Neha (Customer Success) to confirm implementation effort and ops impact, and Rishi for commercial.

Quick summary for internal review:
- External ask: include Premium Support (named TAM, 24/7) for first 12 months at no charge.
- Technical ask: build custom Azure AD connector that supports SSO in VPC and group sync (doc attached).
- Commercial ask: 20% onboarding credit on year-one committed spend in exchange for a 24-month term.
- Timeline requested: onboarding to start week of Nov 2.

Marissa/Neha — can you confirm estimated PS hours and whether the connector is covered under standard onboarding? If not, please advise recommended dev hours and whether we can absorb the work or billable. Rishi — please advise what flexibility we have on the discount and whether this requires an executive waiver / deal desk signoff.

I’ll coordinate once we have cost/risks.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2026 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Premium support + custom Azure AD connector — scope & ask

Connor —

Reviewed the TechnicalSpec and Gentrix_SOW_v1. Short answer: the Azure AD connector is non-standard and will require dedicated engineering cycles (estimated 120-160 hours), testing inside their VPC, and additional security validation. This is outside a typical onboarding SOW.

My recommendation: escalate for executive approval if we are to include the connector as a no-charge deliverable. Options to consider:
- Option A (conservative): Bill connector dev as a one-time PS fee (estimate $36k) + include Premium Support at no charge for 6 months.
- Option B (aggressive concession): Absorb 100 hours of connector work, customer covers remaining hours; include Premium Support free for 12 months; provide a 15% onboarding credit (not 20%).

If leadership is comfortable with commercial concession, we should cap covered dev hours and require a change order for overages. I attached a cost_breakdown.xlsx with rough math. Also note: including Premium Support for 12 months with a named TAM increases our near-term support cost and will impact capacity planning — Neha, we’ll need to confirm TAM assignment and ramp.

Marissa Cole
VP, Professional Services | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: ESCALATION: Gentrix commercial waiver request (deal GENT-2026-042)

Markus / Karthik —

Gentrix is a strategic target for our enterprise vertical and is asking for an outsized concession: Premium Support included for 12 months + custom Azure AD connector as part of onboarding and a 20% onboarding credit. They are committing to a 24-month contract and a substantive committed spend, but the ask exceeds standard playbook thresholds.

Commercial ask (what I recommend we consider):
- Approve up to 15% onboarding credit on year-one committed spend.
- Include Premium Support for 6 months at no charge (named TAM optional afterwards).
- Commit to cover up to 100 dev hours for the connector; any hours beyond that to be billed at standard PS rates.
- Legal to sign an amendment that limits SLA credits and sets clear acceptance criteria.

If you approve, PS will prepare SOW_v2 reflecting the capped hours and support term. We want to avoid fully waiving dev fees or offering 12 months free support without exec signoff.

Please advise — we need decision to lock Nov 2 start window.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ESCALATION: Gentrix commercial waiver request (deal GENT-2026-042)

Team —

I approve a constrained concession for Gentrix as follows:
- 15% onboarding credit on year-one committed spend.
- Premium Support included for 6 months at no charge (named TAM after 6 months will be reviewed).
- Redwood will cover up to 100 dev hours for the Azure AD connector; bill any overage per standard PS rates.

Conditions: legal to add amendment with acceptance criteria and a cap on SLA credits. Karthik, please confirm you can sign the SLA exception and ensure this does not create a precedent for other deals. Keep margin impact within forecasts.

Markus Klein
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Banerjee <aisha.b@gentrix.com>, Gentrix Procurement <procurement@gentrix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: Gentrix terms & next steps (SOW v2 + DocuSign)

Hi Aisha / Ravi —

Thanks for your patience. Leadership has approved a constrained concession. Confirmed commercial terms:
- 15% onboarding credit applied to year-one committed spend (per deal schedule).
- Premium Support included at no charge for the first 6 months; named TAM assignment will be scheduled during onboarding and reviewed after month 5.
- Redwood will cover up to 100 dev hours for the custom Azure AD connector; any additional hours will be billed per standard PS rates (outlined in SOW v2).

Attached: SOW_Gentrix_v2.pdf (updated scope and capped hours). I’ve also sent the amendment via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign?txn=gentrix-sow-v2. Please review and sign so we can start the onboarding week of Nov 2.

Next steps for Gentrix:
1) Review SOW_v2 and DocuSign amendment.
2) Confirm PO or countersigned contract by Oct 23 to preserve resource window.
3) Once countersigned, PS will schedule TAM ramp and kick off connector work (we’ll allocate an initial 40 hours in sprint 1).

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: SOW_Gentrix_v2.pdf
